changelog.summary: Fixes CMS-authored posts never appearing publicly: the editor published the native catalog entry with status 'draft', so categories/tags merged while every public list filtered the post out. The editor now uses an explicit draft/pending-approval/pending-confirmation/published/partial/failed/ambiguous state machine, publishes with status 'published', and reports a verified but search-index-pending post as partial instead of success. Also adds first-class qortal:// links, https copy-with-badge behaviour, full-text search with a versioned qms-cms-search-index@1 (CMS and imports), footer/header attribution fixes, and a durable completion-notification module. The CMS also corrects its pre-publication fee quote to include the search-index resource (three signatures, not two).

desktop.changelog: Rebuilt with the CMS 0.8.0-alpha.5 fee-quote correction on top of 0.8.0-alpha.6. Desktop sources are otherwise unchanged.

publisher.changelog: Unchanged in this release; the Publisher artifact is byte-identical to 0.8.0-alpha.2.

cms.changelog: CMS 0.8.0-alpha.4: publish state machine and status fix (CMS posts now appear in Posts/Latest/detail/terms after verified publication); first-class qortal:// links accepted by the editor and sanitizer and opened through Hub OPEN_NEW_TAB; https links copy with a transient badge; live full-text search over a versioned qms-cms-search-index@1 with Unicode and phrase support; 'Qortal Migration Studio CMS' footer attribution without QDN-name labels; hardcoded 'Qortal QDN publication' eyebrow removed. Corrects the pre-publication fee quote to three resources (content, native catalog index, search index).
